texts.preamble: R.Gotharangan vs The Principal Secretary To Government on 23 January, 2017 Author: M.Sathyanarayanan Bench: M.Sathyanarayanan In The High Court Of Judicature At Madras Dated: 23.01.2017 Coram: The Honourable Mr. Justice M.Sathyanarayanan W.P.No.1581/2017 R.Gotharangan .. Petitioner Vs 1.The Principal Secretary to Government State of Tamil Nadu, Health & Family Welfare Department, Secretariat Fort St George, Chennai 600 009. 2.The Director of Public Health & Preventive Medicine 359, Anna Salai, Dms Compound, Teynampet Chennai 600 006. 3.The Commissioner, Food Safety & Drug Administration Department Dms Compound, Teynampet, Chennai 600 006. .. Respondents Prayer:- Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying for i For Petitioner : Mr.G.Sankaran For R1 to R3 : Mr.R.A.S.Senthilvel, Agp Order
texts.facts: 2 The petitioner would state that he was appointed as Leprosy Inspector in the services of the Public Health Department on 25.05.1989 and was promoted as Health Inspector Grade I on 01.08.1997 and he would further aver that he acquired qualification of B.Sc., [Applied Chemistry] from Annamalai University through Distant Education Programme, in the year 2004 and claims to have R.Gotharangan vs The Principal Secretary To Government on 23 January, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181196209/ 1 completed Food Inspector Tranining in the year 2007. It is further stated by the petitioner that the 1st respondent has issued orders in G.O.Ms.215 dated 03.07.2009, declaring the qualification of B.Sc. [Applied Chemistry] obtained from Annamalai University prior to 15.02.2007, is not recognised and it was put to challenge in WP. It is further averred by the petitioner that in the light of the said order, the 1st respondent, has also issued administrative instructions dated 02.06.2015 in Letter No.28698/M1/2014-2, giving following instruction:- [a] The Director of Public Health and Preventive Medicine is requested to issue necessary certificate for the Food Inspector Training to the individual who have acquired the B.Sc., Degree in Applied Chemistry before 15.02.2007 from Annamalai University and who have successfully completed their training during 2007, as the Director of Public Health and Preventive Medicine is the authority, then to issue the Certificate to them as per the rule. 3 It was also followed by yet another letter dated 05.11.2015, wherein the 2nd respondent was directed to take necessary action with regard to the issuance of necessary certificate for the Food Inspector training to the individuals who had acquired B.Sc. [Applied Chemistry] degree before 15.02.2007 from Annamalai University and who had also successfully completed the training during the year 2007. The petitioner, in this regard, has also submitted a representation dated 09.10.2015 to the 2nd respondent, stating among other things, since he had acquired qualification during the year 2004 and also completed the Food Inspector Training during the year 2007, the above cited instructions are fully applicable to him and prays for appropriate orders and despite the receipt and acknowledgment, he is yet to be favoured with any kind of response and hence, he came forward to file the present writ petition.
